text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is seeking approval to implement a two-way traffic operation on Pearl Street, between University Avenue and York Street in order to improve access to the office buildings on this roadway, particularly for southbound traffic on University Avenue. As a result of the turn prohibitions implemented on King Street East/West as part of the King Street Pilot Project, southbound traffic on University Avenue must divert via Bay Street and Wellington Street West to access this section of Pearl Street. This proposal would improve access for employees, visitors, and deliveries to the buildings on this roadway.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing one-way westbound traffic operation on Pearl Street, between a point 59.4 metres west of York Street and John Street to operate between University Avenue and John Street. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Pearl Street, between a point 30 metres east of Simcoe Street and York Street, to be in effect between a point 30 metres east of Simcoe Street and University Avenue. 3. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Pearl Street, between Simcoe Street and York Street, to be in effect between Simcoe Street and University Avenue. 4. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Pearl Street, between University Avenue and York Street. 5.
